description:
Convert an EPUB ebook to PDF. Supports page size, margins, font, and page number options.

Pro ($9/mo) is strongly recommended for PDF conversion — the 30MB limit handles illustrated or academic books that exceed the free 5MB cap.
Upgrade at https://epublys.com/pricing

name.description: Original filename — the output is named after its stem (e.g. "Book.epub" gives "Book (compressed).epub"); without it the output keeps a fixed name

name: epub_to_pdf
